method: Spline vectorization of the selected primary wordmark and compact FB study; threshold masks, speckle removal, cubic Bézier outlines. Not an independently redrawn typeface.

minimums.wordmark: 180 CSS px wide recommended; 160 px minimum after contextual review
minimums.monogram: 24 px minimum; use 32 px or larger for app/navigation
minimums.favicon: 32 px artwork; inspect browser 16 px downsample in context

clear_space: At least half the capital letter height around the full wordmark; at least one quarter compact-mark height around monogram.
usage: Full wordmark is the primary identity. FB is a compact application mark. Keep flat fills, preserve proportions, no shadows or textures.
